_comment: Diagnostic scheme that should actually emit. Two halves, and both are needed: `diagnostic-logmask` forces the global trace mask so Log_msg stops returning at its gate, and `diagnostic-logsink` points the sink it then calls at VxWorks logMsg instead of the no-op the vendor shipped. Do NOT add `diagnostic-logging` as well - it repoints the same sink at Log_msg and the two would call each other. NOT FLASHED: the branch target is verified in emulation only, and where logMsg's output surfaces on this unit is the open question (issue #94). Expect a lot of output on every path the firmware takes; do not drive on it.
